headline: DoorDash unveils AI text ordering and drone delivery at Dash Forward
summary: At its Dash Forward 2026 event, DoorDash announced text-message ordering through an AI agent, building on its Ask DoorDash chatbot from June, plus drone deliveries and retail returns. Drone deliveries will first launch in northern California with partners including Chipotle and Popeyes.

claims.statement: DoorDash announced new features including AI-powered text-message ordering, drone deliveries, and retail returns.

sources.quote: You can text DoorDash’s AI bot to ‘order my usual’ and it will figure the rest out
DoorDash launches an AI agent you can text to order food

claims.statement: Drone deliveries will first launch in northern California, with Chipotle and Popeyes among initial partners.

sources.quote: DoorDash drone deliveries are first coming to northern California with Chipotle and Popeyes on board

claims.statement: The announcements were made at DoorDash's annual Dash Forward 2026 event, which unveiled a six-propeller drone aircraft.

sources.quote: DoorDash unveiled the six-propeller aircraft that will be used in its new drone delivery business at its annual Dash Forward 2026 event

claims.statement: The text-ordering feature builds on the Ask DoorDash AI chatbot introduced in June.

sources.quote: builds on capabilities that the Ask DoorDash AI chatbot introduced to the DoorDash app in June

claims.statement: TechCrunch frames the AI ordering agent as DoorDash's bid to gain an edge over rivals Uber Eats and Grubhub.

sources.quote: DoorDash is looking to gain an edge over rivals Uber Eats and Grubhub
